# agentable-canvas

> Embeddable AI canvas framework — Lit embed, tldraw whiteboard, panel IR, six generic agent tools, HITL mutations, and domain packs.

Embeddable AI canvas: chat panel, draggable workspace, voice transport (Gemini Live), and panel registry with spec IR validation. Drop one tag into any page — React, Vue, or plain HTML.

## Package

- [README](README.md): quick start, exports, development commands
- [Architecture](docs/development/ARCHITECTURE.md): whiteboard substrate, PanelShape, registry
- [Adopter quickstart](docs/setup/ADOPTER_QUICKSTART.md): two-panel React from git pin
- [Release process](docs/setup/RELEASE.md): semver, GitHub Packages, consumer SHA pinning
- [Interop matrix](docs/development/INTEROP_MATRIX.md): embed + React smoke commands

## Agent integration 

- [Framework skill](.cursor/skills/agentable-framework/SKILL.md): panel tools, spec IR, safety invariants, workflows
- [Panel tools reference](.cursor/skills/agentable-framework/references/panel-tools.md): list/open/fill/compose/patch/run_panel_action
- [Spec IR reference](.cursor/skills/agentable-framework/references/spec-ir.md): flat node map, bindings, validation
- [Safety invariants](.cursor/skills/agentable-framework/references/safety-invariants.md): HITL, provenance, no trusted HTML
- [Adopt embed workflow](.cursor/skills/agentable-framework/references/workflows/adopt-embed.md)

- [A2UI ingestion](docs/features/a2ui-ingestion-adapter.md): A2UI v1.0 → native IR
